user.title: EireTide
user.description: Choose the tide gauge station to track. Data comes from the Marine Institute's tide prediction service.

manual_station.title: Enter station name
manual_station.description: The station list couldn't be loaded from the Marine Institute. Enter the exact station name, for example: Dublin_Port.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Marine Institute tide data service.
error.unknown_station: No tide predictions were found for that station. Check the spelling and try again.

init.title: Chart Datum offset
init.description: All heights from the Marine Institute are relative to OD Malin, not the Chart Datum most consumer tide apps use. If you know your station's OD-Malin-to-Chart-Datum offset, enter it here (in metres) to also get a chart_datum_estimate_m attribute on the height sensors. Leave at 0 to skip this.
